observations: Direct Custom retains left-half/left-edge framing, five square minis, sword artwork, readable body/cost/order/confirm and gauge layout
Direct closed battle retains actor proportions and visible feet/ground contact, floor/foreground texture boundary, enemy name/HP group spacing and right touch HUD anchors
Managed restored boss keeps its body proportions, ground relationship, fixed HP200/poise bars and player gauge compared with Stage8 managed boss
Keyboard settings and reset dialog preserve Jiki typography, three-column key/clear controls, footer actions and modal visual hierarchy without newly visible clipping or overlap
stateAndPhaseDistinctions: Direct map/seed/nominal Frame0/60 are main-agent supplied capture conditions, not reviewer-executed gameplay checks
Separate native runs may differ in idle animation or glyph/render phase; no pixel-exact equality or motion-stability claim
Managed boss is compared to Stage8 managed boss, not to earlier-stage normal-enemy managed captures; gameplay-specific state remains distinct
limits: No Unity commands, source edits, test execution, input/raycast checks, save validation or runtime ownership/disposal tests performed by reviewer
Static images do not validate factory parameters, checkpoint restoration values/order, input guards, lifecycle identity, focus or frame progression
4K full-image output was viewer-resized; native4kSupplement separately records four representative unscaled lossless in-memory crops. No original PNG was changed.
Dense statuses, warning/effect phases, reward/return UI, physical devices, historical UGUI and listening quality are outside this fifteen-view comparison.

native4kSupplement.method: Read original3840x2160 PNGs using PIL; crop rectangles in memory only, encode losslessPNG data URLs and display without resize. All displayed crops are <=920x210, so no tool resize notice occurred. Original PNG bytes and product assets unchanged.
